ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because 'laid to rest' folds sale into death: Ooze Eat, Fly South, Inkcap burning out and Undertaker opening Bellies all become Guild triggers, so nearly every card has an off-label use worth hunting for.
ratings_why.distinct: Slot refills echo Deathrattle summoners, but sell-equals-death and death-order positioning (front dies small, back dies big) play unlike today's tribes.

verdict_why: One real loop (Stinkhorn's shop Fruit on Sprouts) and the shop Sprout's size rule need fixing; the rest should settle after that.

points.text: In the shop, a Sprout beside Stinkhorn has Fruit, so selling it for 0 leaves a new, bigger Sprout in the same slot. Repeat for free and you get a lasting Sprout of any size plus an endless Register. Make Stinkhorn's aura fights-only, or say Sprouts never Fruit while recruiting.
A Sprout made while recruiting stays, but X is a live count. Say whether its size freezes when it is made, or whether it becomes the fight count in the next fight.

Undertaker is the best card here for other tribes (Belly opener, Fruit trigger, Mire tank). Using 'beside, on the left' would match the board words, and a golden that picks either side would make placement a choice.
Hero damage: let a Sprout count as having started the fight if the unit it came from did. The Procession would then hit as hard as it wins.
Old Fingers plus selling is a lovely trick: sell a fat unit for its triggers and it still fights. Giving the copies Fruit would tie him into the Procession too.

standouts.why: Clerk Inkcap is a buffer that is also a fuse; Health buffs become fuel, and his own death feeds the count.
Old Fingers turns sold and Flown-South units into fighters and makes empty slots worth something.
Black-Gloved Undertaker has three jobs across tribes: Fruit trigger, Belly opener, sacrifice for Attack.

weakest.why: Crape Spinner is a flat Sprout aura with no decision.
Foxfire Lamplighter does the Spinner's job again in fights, with nothing new to combo.
Hired Mute is a plain counter-grower; fine as a seed but nothing to discover.

flags.note: Stinkhorn beside a Sprout in the shop gives a free sell loop: unbounded Sprout size and Register.
Grandmother Bootlace reads the Register, which the Stinkhorn loop or heavy Cordwainer selling can inflate fast.
Bootlace Cordwainer with Candlesnuff Abbess and Pallbearer stacks many Sprouts per death; capped at six chains a fight, but worth a sim.
Whether a shop-made Sprout's X is fixed or recounted in fights is not stated.
Clerk Inkcap's permanent Health loss during a fight: does it reduce fight Health, permanent Health, or both?
